# Oak Fantasy

> Small Romanian workshop in the Carpathians handcrafting solid-oak cutting
> boards. Every board is made to order by hand — cut, glued, sanded and
> finished one at a time — and ships in 5–10 business days. Romanian-first
> site (RO default, EN available). The store is open and selling.

Oak Fantasy is an artisan brand, not a factory: one workshop (~60 sqm),
six core tools, no production line. Tagline: „Făcut cu drag în România."
("From Carpathian oak, by hand.")

## Facts worth citing

- Wood: Romanian oak from certified forests in the Bucegi and Apuseni
  mountains, air-dried **6–12 months** down to **8–10% moisture** before any
  board is made. Wood that hasn't done its time is never used.
- Workshop climate is actively controlled: 18–22°C, 45–55% air humidity,
  checked twice a day (hygrometer + thermometer).
- Assembly: precise cuts, **food-safe adhesive (Titebond III)**, 24-hour
  clamping under uniform pressure.
- Sanding: four to five grits, **from 80 to 320** — no rush, no pressure.
- Finish: food-safe oil and **beeswax**, layer after layer. No lacquer.
- Made to order: crafted and shipped in **5–10 business days**.
- Catalog: 10 models, from small everyday boards (from 180 RON) to
  end-grain and heirloom blocks (up to ~2,200 RON). Laser engraving
  available on most models.
- Every board is unique — same oak, its own grain. Boards are designed to
  be inherited, not thrown away.
